mentions.name: rookery
mentions.description: A PGP-first, self-hostable email server that ships with a web mail client and modern email standards out of the box. Aims to hand the decentralized email standard back to users, letting anyone with some self-hosting/Linux knowledge run instances for themselves, friends/family, or business. Initially built with heavy AI assistance as a learning project about the email standard, and now being rewritten/restructured/refactored line by line to stabilize it and prove its security.
mentions.problem: Privacy-minded people have only a few easy-to-use email options, such as ProtonMail or Tuta, rather than control over the decentralized email standard itself.
mentions.audience: Everyone with a bit of self-hosting/Linux knowledge, who wants to run their own instances for themselves, their friends/family, or business.
